SERV.description: Serviceability Parameters (SERV). Deflection serviceability check parameters for KDS-41-30-2022 steel design; both fields are optional design controls applied directly in OnSet.

DEFLECT_CONTROL.description: Deflection control limit; allowable deflection ratio (e.g. span/300). Maps to dDefLim.

DAF.description: Deflection Amplification Factor. Maps to dDAF.
